title: Change Order Sequence Multiplier on Professional Services Projects Restart Fees
content:
On Professional Services Projects, the place of a restart change order in the engagement's sequence of signed change orders scales its administration fee.

The administration fee of a restart change order is multiplied by 0.5 when the change order is the engagement's first signed change order, by 1.25 when it is the third or a later one, and left unchanged when it is the second, the count being the signed scope additions, scope reductions and schedule changes on the engagement, this one included, which the engagement's count of signed change orders also records.

| Position of the restart change order among the signed scope additions, scope reductions and schedule changes | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| first | 0.5 |
| second | unchanged |
| third or later | 1.25 |

Termination notices, acceptance sign-offs and acceptance rejections are not counted, and neither are change orders that are not signed.

Hypothetical illustration: an engagement with one signed scope addition and one signed schedule change before the restart change order counts the restart change order as its third, so the fee is multiplied by 1.25.
